verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents automatic reactive behaviour: the control plane corrects drift on its own, an alpha flag enables real-time compositions, and users configure function pipelines instead of writing controllers. A community comparison also notes it has active controllers that react to failures. These are declarative reconciliation loops, not explicitly user-defined event→action rules, so the story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: documented user-authored event triggers or rules (e.g., watch/event-based operations), explicit trigger-condition configuration, and hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
